def: to suspend; figuratively (through hesitation) to be uncertain; by implication (of mental dependence) to habituate

occurrences.text: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:

And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh–gilead, which had stolen them from the street of Beth–shan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:
And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt him.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
